exceptions.reason: minimatch >=7.0.0 <11.0.1: a denial of service from an attacker-chosen glob pattern. Every affected copy left is in build tooling, never in the app: minimatch 10 in gui through typescript-eslint (@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree), minimatch 9 and 10 in desktop through electron-builder (@electron/universal and others), minimatch 10 in extension through typescript-eslint, @vscode/vsce and mocha. They run only on fixed patterns from this repository's own config. The locked releases of those tools do not allow a patched minimatch; npm audit's only offer is a downgrade to older releases (typescript-eslint 8.36, electron-builder 25.1, mocha 11.4), which we do not take. The root package's own copy is already on the patched 11.0.8. Re-check when those tools update.

glob >=9.0.0 <=14.0.1: a cancelled glob can keep walking the filesystem after its AbortSignal fires. The only affected copy left is glob 13 in extension: a direct devDependency there (^13.0.6, not imported by the extension's code) that mocha and @vscode/vsce 3 also use to run the tests and package the extension. None of it ships, and nothing there passes an AbortSignal. Clearing it needs extension's own glob raised to ^14.0.2 and mocha and vsce releases on a patched glob (or without glob, as vsce 4 is), to do as their own change. The root package's own copy is already on the patched 14.0.6. Re-check when mocha updates.

picomatch <=4.0.7: a regular-expression denial of service from an attacker-chosen glob pattern with repeated extglobs. There is no patched release (every version up to the latest, 4.0.7, is affected), so no update can clear it. The only copy that ships is picomatch 2.3.2 in the root package, through globby (micromatch) and pm2 (anymatch, readdirp). src/ calls globby only with fixed literal patterns and ignore lists written in src/analyzers and src/core/doctor.ts, never with gitignore files or patterns from a repository or a user, and never asks pm2 to watch files. Every other copy is build or test tooling and never ships: picomatch 4 through vite, vitest and tinyglobby in root and gui (not in the built GUI bundle), through fdir and tinyglobby in desktop, and picomatch 2 and 4 through micromatch and tinyglobby in extension. Accepted by the owner on 18 Nov. Re-check when picomatch publishes a fix.
